description: Weather-aware trip planning: is the weather right for an outdoor plan? Pass destination (place name) or lat and lon; optional date (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 15 days ahead), time_window, plan_type and transportation_modes. Returns JSON with the forecast for that day (current conditions when no date is sent), a rule-based outdoor_fit rating, tradeoffs and transportation exposure notes. $0.03 via x402; not charged for unknown places, unsupported dates or a weather source failure. This MCP never pays: it returns the live result if the backend answers, or the request URL and x402 payment metadata for a client that can pay.
name: plan_weather_aware_trip
